title: Transformer Architecture Deep Dive
key_concepts: Scaled dot-product attention: Q, K, V matrices
Positional encoding: absolute vs rotary (RoPE) vs ALiBi
Transformer block: attention + FFN + LayerNorm + residual connections
expected_skills: Describe the role of each component in a transformer block
Explain why positional encoding is necessary
Describe how causal masking enables autoregressive generation
sample_questions: Explain the self-attention mechanism. How are Q, K, and V matrices computed and used?
Why do we scale the dot product by sqrt(d_k) in the attention formula?
What is the purpose of positional encoding and how does RoPE differ from sinusoidal encoding?
Explain how causal masking works in a decoder-only transformer model like GPT.
